author: TeIq
content: APPROVE. router_with_state now reads POLARIS_FRONTEND_DIST env and installs a tower-http ServeDir as the router fallback when set. Uses .fallback(ServeFile::new(index.html)) — NOT .not_found_service() — so SPA client-side routes (/login, /setup, /case/...) return 200 with index.html. tower-http feature 'fs' added to workspace pin. Verified: GET /, /login, /setup, /oauth/client-metadata.json all return 200 from polaris-backend with POLARIS_FRONTEND_DIST=polaris-frontend/dist set. /api/whoami returns 401 without session (correct gate). Build + clippy + fmt clean. Boundary 0/30.
